item.title: España lleva 13 años pagando por un almacén de gas que jamás llegó a almacenar nada, generó más de 1.000 terremotos y sufriremos hasta 2044
item.description: A 1.750 metros bajo el lecho marino, frente a Vinaròs, hay un almacén de gas que nunca ha vendido ni un solo metro cúbico. Cuatro gobiernos distintos, dos colores políticos y 4.700 millones de euros en total, según la propia orden ministerial de 2017, el Castor sigue ahí: sellado, hibernando y, aun así, generando facturas. La última: 200 millones de euros , con previsión —otra más— de cerrarlos "este verano" y gastar otros 50 millones en desmantelamiento . Sumado todo, la factura pública y de los consumidores ya se acerca a los 1.700 millones que el ministro José Manuel Soria calculó en 2013… Fuente: Xataka.

item.title: ‘It cost me many friendships’: former Brazil military chief reveals inside struggle to stop Bolsonaro’s coup
item.description: Carlos de Almeida Baptista Júnior describes 2022 meeting in new book as ex-leader’s son vies with Lula for presidency The far-right populist Jair Bolsonaro was in his final days as Brazil’s president when, six weeks after losing the election and still refusing to recognise the result, he summoned the heads of the armed forces to a meeting. The defence minister, Gen Paulo Sérgio Nogueira de Oliveira, took out a document from a plastic folder and handed copies to the commanders of the navy, army and air force. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Germany: AfD eyes historic state election win
item.description: In Saxony-Anhalt, AfD – Germany's far-right party – is polling at 40% or more of voting intentions, just days ahead of the regional election on 6 September 2026. If the AfD wins an absolute majority of seats, it could soon be in charge here. It would be the first time since 1945 that a far-right party has led a German region. To get there, the party is banking on the promise of a return to "the Germany of old", leaning on East German symbols such as Simson mopeds and retro aesthetics. It is a well-established strategy that draws on a gnawing sense of decline for decades and increasing… Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Ferrari nunca fabricó este 599 GTB: un diseñador lo ha transformado en un homenaje al Daytona familiar de 1972 único
item.description: Cada vez es más habitual que los fabricantes de coches de lujo creen ediciones especiales y actualizadas de sus viejas glorias. Lo hemos visto, sin ir más lejos, en Ferrari con su Ferrari 849 Testarrosa , o en Bugatti con el F.K.P Hommage que rinde homenaje al Bugatti Veyron y a su creador. Sin embargo, hay ocasiones en las que son los propios usuarios quienes ponen su dinero sobre la mesa para fabricar sus propios homenajes únicos y exclusivos. En este caso, el resultado se llama Daytona Shooting Brake Hommage, un homenaje al Ferrari 365 GTB4 Daytona Shooting Brake fabricado en 1972. Un… Fuente: Xataka.

item.description: More than three decades after Germany’s 1990 reunification, lasting east-west divisions may be thrown into stark relief at Sunday’s election in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt. The anti-immigration and Moscow-friendly Alternative for Germany (AfD) is expected to win big and even hopes to take power at the state level, which would be a first for a far-right party in German post-war history. item.title: Philippine Vice-President Duterte-Carpio posts bail over alleged Marcos death threat
item.description: Philippine Vice-President Sara Duterte-Carpio posted bail at a Manila courthouse on Saturday, a day after an arrest warrant was issued over her alleged death threat against the country’s president. Duterte-Carpio was charged last month with “grave threats” stemming from a late-night news briefing in which she claimed to have hired a hitman to kill President Ferdinand Marcos Jnr, his wife and a congressman cousin should she be cut down first. item.title: Informe desde Londres: Reino Unido reafirma soberanía en las Malvinas tras declaraciones de Milei
item.description: El Gobierno británico reafirmó su soberanía sobre las Malvinas tras las declaraciones del presidente argentino, Javier Milei. El ministro de Defensa y el ministro de Exteriores de Reino Unido rechazaron contundentemente la afirmación de Milei de que "las Malvinas son argentinas" y aseguraron que si las islas son británicas es porque "así lo decidieron los isleños" y "la declaración dice más sobre la política interna de Argentina que sobre las islas". Nuestra corresponsal Luisa Pulido nos amplió la información. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Russian drone strikes Ukraine’s security service headquarters
item.description: A Russian drone struck the headquarters of Ukraine's SBU security services on Friday, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said, accusing Moscow of aiming directly at the SBU head's personal office. Zelensky said he had instructed the SBU to deliver an "appropriate, tangible response" to the strike, while Ukraine's Foreign Minister Andriy Sybiga described it as a "major escalation". FRANCE 24's Emmanuelle Chaze reports from Kyiv, Ukraine. Publicado también por: France 24 - English, Sky News - World. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: US job market rebounds with 162,000 new jobs, far surpassing expectations
item.description: The US job market rebounded in August as employers added a surprising 162,000 jobs. The unemployment rate stayed at a low 4.1 per cent. The jobs report, issued by the Labour Department on Friday, could be good news for President Donald Trump two months before midterm elections in which the health of the economy is weighing on voters’ minds. Hiring far exceeded the 65,000 forecasters had expected, according to a poll by FactSet. Labour Department revisions also looked good, adding 55,000 to June... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
